events.text: {npc} turns up at your door with a jar of wine and two cups. 'I was passing,' {he} says. Nobody passes your door.

mem.note: drank with me until dawn

effects.log: You talk about everything and nothing. {He} drinks, you keep to tea, and by morning you have a friend.

choices.text: Thank {him}, but you need to train

mem.note: was honest with me

effects.log: {He} laughs and leaves the jar. 'For when you are human again.'

events.text: {npc} shows you a secret place behind the waterfall where the fish are as long as your arm.

mem.note: kept our waterfall secret

effects.log: It becomes your place. Neither of you ever tells anyone.

choices.text: Tell the other children, so everyone can come

mem.note: told everyone about our secret place

effects.log: By summer half the village swims there. {npc} does not speak to you for a week, then forgives you.

events.text: {npc} asks you for a spar, no blood, just to see how far you have both come.

mem.note: gave me a real fight

ok.log: You win, barely. {npc} laughs through a split lip.

mem.note: gave me a real fight

fail.log: {npc} wins. You learn more from the loss than from a month of training.

mem.note: let me win and thought I did not notice

effects.log: {He} notices. {He} is touched anyway.

events.text: {npc} arrives out of breath. 'Bandits took my younger brother on the mountain road. They want 300 taels. I have forty. Please.'

mem.note: went up the mountain for my brother

ok.log: You break the bandits' camp and carry the boy down. {npc} bows until {his} forehead touches the road.

mem.note: bled for my brother

fail.log: You get the boy out, but a blade finds your side. You barely make it down.

mem.note: paid my brother's ransom

effects.log: The boy comes home. {npc} swears to repay every tael.

mem.note: turned me away when my brother was taken

effects.log: {npc} looks at you as if seeing you for the first time.

events.text: {npc} is drowning in gambling debts to the Black Wind moneylenders and asks you for 50 taels.

mem.note: paid my debt to the moneylenders

effects.log: {npc} grips your hand. 'Never again,' {he} swears.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell {him} to stop gambling

mem.note: lectured me when I needed help

effects.log: {He} leaves angry. You wonder if you were right.

events.text: {npc} is stuck at {npc_realm}. {He} asks if you would look at {his} breathing, just once.

mem.note: taught me when I was stuck

effects.log: Teaching {npc} shows you gaps in your own method. You both come out stronger.

mem.note: would not share even a word

effects.log: Some things are not shared. {npc} nods stiffly.

events.text: {npc} finds you after {debt_years} years. 'I have not forgotten that you {debt}. Take this.' {He} presses a jade box into your hands.

mem.note: let me repay my debt

effects.log: Inside is a hundred-year ginseng root. {npc} walks away lighter.

choices.text: Refuse: there was never a debt

mem.note: said I never owed anything

effects.log: {npc} stares, then laughs until {he} cries. You have made a friend for life.

events.text: {npc} slips a note under your door at midnight: 'A debt repaid. Do not take the mountain road tomorrow. — for when you {debt}.'

effects.log: The next day you hear the mountain road was watched by men with crossbows. You never learn whose.

choices.text: Take the mountain road anyway, sword ready

ok.log: The crossbowmen in the pass were not expecting someone who expected them. The road is quiet after that.

fail.deathCause: crossbow bolts on the mountain road
fail.log: You should have listened. You crawl home with a bolt in your shoulder.

events.text: You are cornered by three men from a rival sect in a mountain town when {npc} drops from the rooftop between you and them. 'This one saved my life once,' {he} says. 'Go home.'

effects.log: They go home. {npc} walks off before you can thank {him}.

events.text: A cart-driver's quarrel in a market town turns into knives, and you are the one standing in the road. {npc} shoulders through the crowd and takes the first blow meant for you. 'You stood up for me once,' {he} says, grinning through the blood. 'We are even. Now walk away.'

effects.log: The knives go back into their sleeves. {npc} wipes {his} mouth and tells you to buy the next round, and not to tell anyone how it started.

events.text: You do not hear the three riders until {npc} is already in the road in front of your horse, holding up one hand. 'I remember who gave me the lamp that night,' {he} says. 'Turn back. I will tell you why when you are older, or I am.'

effects.log: The riders see who stands there and think better of it. {npc} watches you go, and is gone by the time you look back.

events.text: The inn door bursts in, and a debt-collector's men come for you over a matter you thought was settled. {npc}, who happened to be at the next table, puts a coin on the board and says, 'Whatever {he} owes, I owe more to {him}.' The room goes still.

effects.log: The men count the coin twice and leave. {npc} will not take it back, and will not say why it was so ready in {his} sleeve.

events.text: {npc}, now at {npc_realm}, blocks your path on the road. '{grudge_years} years ago, you {grudge}. I have not forgotten one day of it. Draw.'

mem.note: beat me again, on the road

ok.log: You win. {npc} kneels in the dust, shaking with rage, not fear.

fail.log: {npc} wins. {He} looks down at you. 'Now we are even.' {He} leaves you in the dirt.

mem.note: apologised, finally

ok.log: You bow. The road is silent a long time. Then {npc} sheathes {his} sword.

mem.note: apologised like a coward

fail.log: 'Too late,' {npc} says, and cuts your cheek to prove it.

effects.log: {npc} freezes. The sword point drops. '...Fine. We are even. Next time I will not stop.'

events.text: At the sect tournament, {npc} steps into the ring and points at you. The crowd goes quiet: everyone knows you {grudge_of}.

mem.note: humiliated me in front of the whole sect, again

ok.log: You win in front of the whole sect. {npc} leaves the ring without a word.

fail.log: {npc} wins. Half the sect cheers. You smile, and start training that night.

mem.note: refused to face me

effects.log: The crowd mutters. {npc} smirks. You know that face will return.

events.text: A letter arrives written in blood: '{grudge_years} years ago you {grudge}. Dawn, at the Broken Pine. To the death. — {npc}'

ok.npcDie: your sword at the Broken Pine
ok.log: At dawn, under the Broken Pine, it ends. You bury {npc} yourself.

effects.log: The murim calls you a coward for a season. You are alive to hear it.

mem.note: came to talk instead of kill

ok.log: You talk until the sun is high. {npc} walks away alive, and so do you.

fail.log: Talking fails. You win the fight, but spare {him}. It will not be the last time you meet.

choices.text: (You remember this) You know every move {he} will make

ok.npcDie: your sword at the Broken Pine
ok.log: You watched this duel from the losing side once. Every feint, every lunge: you knew them all. It ends quickly, and differently.

fail.log: Knowing the moves is not the same as stopping them. But you live, which is more than last time.

events.text: Rumours are going round the town that you cheat at duels and steal from the people who host you. Everyone knows they started with {npc}.

mem.note: made a fool of me in the market

ok.log: You make {npc} look ridiculous in front of the whole market. The rumours die. {His} hatred does not.

fail.log: It turns into a shouting match. The rumours only grow.

choices.text: Ignore it and let your deeds answer

effects.log: The rumours fade in a year. Mostly.

events.text: A servant at your inn whispers that a stranger paid well to learn which room you sleep in, and which road you take. The description sounds a great deal like {npc}.

choices.text: Change rooms and roads, and sleep with your sword

effects.log: You change everything. For a few weeks, you feel watched.

mem.note: caught me plotting

ok.log: You catch {npc} with a map of your route. {He} flees. The plot is over, for now.

fail.log: {npc} is ready for you. You escape, but now {he} knows you know.

effects.log: Who would want to kill you? You sleep well. For now.

events.text: For three nights in a row, a crow sits on your window, and on the third morning you find a black thread tied to your door. An old murim sign: someone has paid for your death. You remember the way {npc} looked at you.

effects.log: You stop eating in public and sleep in a different place each night.
It is only a crow.

events.text: Night, on a lonely road. Four masked men step out of the trees, and behind them, not bothering to hide {his} face, {npc}.

ok.npcDie: your sword on the night road
ok.log: When it is over, you are the only one standing. {npc} dies with {his} hatred still in {his} eyes.

fail.deathCause: an ambush on the night road
fail.log: You break through, bleeding from a dozen cuts, and crawl to a farmhouse by dawn.

ok.log: You vanish into the forest. {npc} will have to try again.

fail.deathCause: an ambush on the night road
fail.log: They catch you at the river. You get away with your life, and little else.

choices.text: Remind {him} of the debt between you

effects.log: {npc} hesitates, then raises a hand. The masked men melt into the trees. 'Once,' {he} says. 'Only once.'

choices.text: (I remember this) Leave the road before they strike

effects.log: You remember this road, and this night. You were never on it: from the trees you watch {npc} wait for someone who does not come.

choices.text: (You remember this) You know where they are hiding

effects.log: You remember every shadow of this road from the night you died on it. This time you come at them from behind the trees. {npc} never gets to strike.

events.text: Because you have been careful, you see them first: masked men waiting at the bridge, and {npc} among them.

ok.log: They never get to spring their trap. {npc} does not get up.

fail.log: You scatter them, but {npc} escapes. So do you, barely.

effects.log: You slip away unseen. {npc} waits at the bridge all night for nobody.

events.text: {npc} walks with you under the plum blossoms and says nothing for a long time. Then: 'When all this is over, I would like to grow old somewhere quiet. With you.'

mem.note: married me under the plum trees

effects.log: You marry in spring. For a while the murim feels very far away.

choices.text: Not yet. Your path comes first

mem.note: chose the path over me, for now

effects.log: {npc} smiles sadly. 'I will ask again.'

choices.text: Tell {him} gently it can never be

mem.note: turned me away under the plum trees

effects.log: {npc} bows and leaves. The blossoms keep falling.

events.text: You learn that {npc} has been selling your techniques to a rival sect, and telling them your weaknesses.

mem.note: exposed me to the whole sect

ok.log: You expose {npc} before the sect elders. {He} is expelled, and swears revenge.

fail.log: {npc} strikes first. You survive, and the truth comes out anyway.

choices.text: Say nothing and change your techniques

effects.log: You rebuild your style in secret. When the rival sect comes, they will be fighting a stranger.

choices.text: (You remember this) You planted false techniques for {him} to steal

effects.log: You remembered this betrayal, so you let {npc} steal pages full of mistakes. The rival sect trains on them for a year before anyone notices.

events.text: {npc} reports to the sect elders that you broke the sect's rules. Half of it is true, which is the dangerous half.

mem.note: made me look like a liar before the elders

ok.log: The elders dismiss the charges. {npc} is sent to clean the latrines for a year.

fail.log: You are fined and confined for a season. You spend it training, and remembering.

effects.log: A season in the punishment cave. Very quiet. Very good for meditation.

choices.text: (You remember this) Bring proof before {he} can speak

mem.note: was always one step ahead of me

effects.log: You walk into the hall with proof of {npc}'s lies before {he} has finished speaking. The elders turn to {him} instead.
